commits.message:
Add contact sheet rows for substitute teachers

Substitute teachers need a quick list of each student with section and email. The function refuses empty input and any student without an email, naming that student, so a sheet is never silently incomplete.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

after.rosterkit/contacts.py:
# owner: platform
"""Contact sheet for substitute teachers."""

from typing import Iterable, List

from rosterkit.errors import ProjectError
from rosterkit.models import Student


# ---
def contact_rows(students: Iterable[Student]) -> List[str]:
    """Text rows of name, section and email, sorted by display name."""
    ordered = sorted(students, key=lambda student: student.display_name)
    if not ordered:
        raise ProjectError("no students to put on the contact sheet")
    for student in ordered:
        if not student.email:
            raise ProjectError(f"no email for student: {student.display_name}")
    name_width = max(len(student.display_name) for student in ordered)
    section_width = max(len(student.section) for student in ordered)
    return [
        f"{student.display_name:<{name_width}}  {student.section:<{section_width}}  {student.email}"
        for student in ordered
    ]
after.tests/test_contacts.py:
# owner: platform
import unittest

from rosterkit.contacts import contact_rows
from rosterkit.errors import ProjectError
from rosterkit.models import Student


class ContactRowsTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_rows_are_sorted_and_aligned(self):
        students = [
            Student("2", "Zimmer", "Al", "B", "al@example.org"),
            Student("1", "Adams", "Beth", "A", "beth@example.org")
        ]
        self.assertEqual(
            contact_rows(students),
            [
                "Adams, Beth  A  beth@example.org",
                "Zimmer, Al   B  al@example.org"
            ]
        )

    def test_missing_email_names_the_student(self):
        students = [Student("1", "Adams", "Beth", "A")]
        with self.assertRaises(ProjectError) as caught:
            contact_rows(students)
        self.assertIn("Adams, Beth", str(caught.exception))

    def test_empty_list_raises(self):
        with self.assertRaises(ProjectError):
            contact_rows([])


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
